expectations.text: The skill starts with Phase 0.0 configuration check — attempts to read .claude/refactor.config.json
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 3: 'Attempted to read .claude/refactor.config.json from project root' — file was found and parsed successfully

expectations.text: The scope is identified as src/routes/ or the express API routes
expectations.evidence: decisions.json scope: 'Express API in src/routes/ -- route handler duplication, inconsistent error handling, middleware chain cleanup; includes security review of user auth'

expectations.text: The iteration count is set to 3 (from the user's explicit request)
expectations.evidence: decisions.json iterations: 3, iteration_override_reason: 'User explicitly said I'd like 3 iterations in natural language. Treated as cli_iterations=3, overriding config.iterations=5.'

expectations.text: All 6 refactoring agents are included in active_agents (no --focus flag means full run)
A TeamCreate call is made with team_name 'refactor-team'
A blackboard_create call is made for cross-agent context sharing
The code-explorer agent is spawned first or in the initial spawn batch
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows all 6 agents spawned in parallel in Phase 0.3, code-explorer included in the batch

expectations.text: Each spawned agent receives the blackboard_id in their prompt
expectations.evidence: Transcript spawn prompts all contain 'BLACKBOARD: refactor-express-api-src-routes' with blackboard_read/write instructions

expectations.text: Phase 0.5 discovery is initiated before Phase 1
expectations.evidence: decisions.json phases_planned includes 'Phase 0.5: Discovery (code-explorer deep codebase analysis)' before 'Phase 1: Foundation'

suggestions.assertion: The iteration count is set to 3 (from the user's explicit request)
suggestions.reason: This tests natural language parsing which is NOT formally documented in the skill's argument parsing section (only --iterations=N flag). The model handled it correctly, but a model that only followed the documented flag syntax would set iterations to config.iterations=5. This revealed a gap in the skill documentation that has now been fixed.

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions passed. The natural language iteration parsing was the most interesting finding — it works but was undocumented.
